lines.en: I fly steadier today than I did yesterday.

lines.zh: 褐翅膀上的眼斑，又绕回来了。
lines.en: Brown wings with eyespots — back again.

lines.zh: 翅根有点酸，再飞一会儿。
lines.en: My wing base aches, but I will fly a little longer.

lines.zh: 这段花路，我闭着眼都能飞。
lines.en: I could fly this flower path blind.

lines.zh: 我闻到了远处花蜜的甜味。
lines.en: I smell sweet nectar from far away.

lines.zh: 别拦我，我要去花海深处。
lines.en: Do not stop me; I am heading deeper into the flowers.
Keep close to my wings and do not fall behind.
Who moved this flowerpot under the tree?

lines.zh: 树冠漏下的光晃得眼花。
lines.en: The light through the canopy swims before my eyes.
I will rest after crossing this dark forest.
One flap of my wings, and off I go.
Dark forest flowers — I circle twice.

lines.zh: 黑森林的花，我照样找得到。
lines.en: Even in the dark forest, I find the flowers.
A flower is opening under the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 花蜜是凉的，昨晚下过雨。
lines.en: The nectar is cold; it rained last night.

lines.zh: 翅膀一扇，花粉就落下来。
lines.en: One beat of my wings and pollen drifts down.

lines.zh: 就这样晒着翅膀也不坏。
lines.en: Basking my wings like this is not bad either.
The eyespot on my wing watches you.

lines.zh: 我该去下一朵花看看了。
lines.en: I should go check the next flower.

lines.zh: 花海的风一停，我就发呆。
lines.en: When the wind over the flowers stops, I drift off.
Is the light on me bright enough?
I have forgotten this flower's name.

lines.zh: 露珠从叶尖滚下去，碎了。
lines.en: A dewdrop rolls off the leaf tip and shatters.

lines.zh: 我停在花瓣上，翅膀合拢。
lines.en: I rest on a petal with my wings folded.
Even dark forest flowers need me.

lines.zh: 黑森林的苔藓晒得暖暖的。
lines.en: The moss in the dark forest is warm in the sun.

lines.zh: 我的眼斑，是画给自己看的。
lines.en: My eyespots are painted for myself.
In the flower field, only wingbeats.

lines.zh: 一只鸟影掠过，我屏住翅膀。
lines.en: A bird's shadow passes, and I freeze my wings.
The reflection in the water is watching me.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的眼斑，我盯着你。
lines.en: You stare at my eyespots, and I stare back.

lines.zh: 你身上有黑森林的苔味。
lines.en: You carry the moss smell of the dark forest.

lines.zh: 你袖口那点颜色真好看。
lines.en: That color on your sleeve is lovely.
You have stood here so long. Are you not tired?
Few flowers bloom in the dark forest.

lines.zh: 你拿着网，是来抓我的吗？
lines.en: You carry a net. Are you here to catch me?

lines.zh: 黑森林的花海，我两头都去。
lines.en: I visit both the dark forest and the flower field.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有黑森林的苔味。
lines.en: There's dark oak moss on your boots.
I often visit the dark forest blooms.
Should I land on your shoulder?
A layer of dust has settled on my wings.
Why does the water taste of iron?
A false eye sits on my wings.
Easy, my wing membrane is thinner than paper.
You rubbed off half the scales on my wing.
I cannot fly, so I can only stay still.

lines.zh: 翅膀被拍了一下，我飞歪了。
lines.en: A swat bent my wing and threw off my flight.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜裂了，只能低飞。
lines.en: My wing membrane tore; I can only fly low.

lines.zh: 花海上，我停得像个种子。
lines.en: On the flower field I rest like a seed.

lines.zh: 我的口器还能卷起来咬。
lines.en: My proboscis can still coil and bite.

lines.zh: 我就落在你指尖闻一下。
lines.en: I will only land on your fingertip and sniff once.
The eyespots on my wings scare off small birds.
Is that flower in your hand a fake one?
Lift that flower a little higher.
You take a step, and I circle you once.
Fine, I do want it.

lines.zh: 我顺着甜味飞过了两条溪。
lines.en: I followed the sweetness across two streams.
That nectar smells sweet, but I am a little afraid.
Is that cup of sweet water for me?

lines.zh: 翅膀上的眼斑，不是白长的。
lines.en: My eyespots aren't for nothing.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的眼斑，正盯着你。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings are watching you.

lines.zh: 翅膀撞歪了，鳞粉撒你一脸。
lines.en: My wing is bent, and scales dust your face.
One tilted wing and my pattern is ruined.
I have wings, not fins.
Go around my flower patch next time.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的眼斑，盯着你。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings watch you.
I settle on the flower field and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 你比黑森林的橡树还硬。
lines.en: You are harder than a dark forest oak.

lines.zh: 你碰掉了我翅上的眼斑。
lines.en: You knocked the eyespot off my wing.
The eyespots on my wings got smeared.

lines.zh: 我沿着花海找了你三天。
lines.en: I searched the flower fields for you for three days.

lines.zh: 我的翅振声，你听见了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the hum of my wings?

lines.zh: 我给你带了一滴最甜的花蜜。
lines.en: I brought you the sweetest drop of nectar.

lines.zh: 跟我绕这棵橡树飞一圈？
lines.en: Will you fly one loop around this oak with me?
The way you circle is lovely.

lines.zh: 黑森林边上，我落在一片叶上。
lines.en: By the dark forest I settle on a leaf.
Let us rest wing to wing for a while.

lines.zh: 你的翅纹在光里会变色。
lines.en: Your wing pattern changes color in the light.
This patch of flowers belongs to the two of us.
I land on your finger.
This bright leaf is mine to line my nest.
I will tuck it under a leaf.
Must have drifted out of the wreck.
Black forests do not offer many flowers.
This berry is ripe at just the right moment.
I will keep this drop of nectar in my honey stomach.
This clump of pollen, I am taking it.
Something drifted down on the water.
I've smelled every flower in the dark forest.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的眼斑，专吓小鸟。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings scare small birds.
That patch of orange must be a nectar source.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的眼斑，是吓你的。
lines.en: The eyespot on my wing is meant to scare you.
Luck has arrived, right in front of me.

lines.zh: 黑森林里这朵花，谁也别碰。
lines.en: This dark-forest bloom is mine alone.
The petal moves, and I settle with it.

lines.zh: 我冲向那朵开得最艳的。
lines.en: I dive at the brightest bloom.
This flower opens for only one morning.

lines.zh: 翅上的眼斑，只是吓唬你。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings are only a bluff.
The flower field's shadow covers me.
That red flower, that is the one.
Around the branch, then around you.

lines.zh: 黑森林哪朵花先开我都知道。
lines.en: I know which flower in the dark forest opens first.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的花瓣暴露了方向。
lines.en: The petals you crushed gave away your direction.

lines.zh: 风再大，我也要落到花心。
lines.en: However strong the wind, I will land on the flower's heart.

lines.zh: 你走得再快，也快不过风。
lines.en: However fast you walk, you cannot outrun the wind.

lines.zh: 追着你的帽檐飞很有趣。
lines.en: Chasing the brim of your hat is fun.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还能再扇三千下。
lines.en: My wings can beat three thousand more times.

lines.zh: 你抬手也挡不住我的路线。
lines.en: Raising your hand will not block my path.
You take one step, and I circle once.

lines.zh: 黑森林的花，我只认一朵。
lines.en: In the dark forest, I know one flower.
The edge of my wing can cut, too.

lines.zh: 我的翅上有个眼斑，看着像眼睛。
lines.en: There's an eye spot on my wing. It looks back.
I settle on the flower field a moment.

lines.zh: 这一下是替被网住的同伴。
lines.en: This one is for the companion caught in your net.
Scales in your eyes now, are they?
Do not step on my flowers. Get away!
I am going for your eyes, so do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我落在花瓣上，一碰就飞。
lines.en: I land on a petal and lift at a touch.
Stay away from my flower patch.
Time to surface for air — I will send you.
Eggshell still clings to my wingtip.

lines.zh: 新开的这朵花，味道真甜。
lines.en: This newly opened flower tastes so sweet.
I have emerged, and the world is so bright.
Let us begin, this sea of flowers.

lines.zh: 我刚从蛹里钻出来，翅还软。
lines.en: I just crawled out of my chrysalis, wings still soft.
The flower field is so big. Where should I land?

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还没完全展开。
lines.en: My wings have not fully spread yet.
First I dry my wings, then I take off.

lines.zh: 这里是黑森林？花不多啊。
lines.en: Is this the dark forest? Not many flowers here.
I know the flowers of the dark forest.
The flame licked the edge of my wing!

lines.zh: 从半空摔到落叶上也疼。
lines.en: Falling from the air onto leaves still hurts.
Wet wings can't fly.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻了我整片翅膀。
lines.en: The blast flipped my whole wing over.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的左翅。
lines.en: An arrow passed through my left wing.
The spell crawled into my antennae.
The nectar is gone and the flowers have wilted.
The thunder leaves my wing veins numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有上升的气流。
lines.en: There is no rising air in the void.
